from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single research paper with its title and bibliography content relevant to the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    referenced_paper_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed papers from the provided collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
